description: Methods the wa-assistant MCP shim MUST refuse when the invoking context is a `<channel source="wa">` envelope. Daemon-side enforcement is defence in depth; the shim is primary. Kept in the daemon repo so plugin PRs can cite the authoritative list.

rationale.contact.block: Lets a compromised contact cut the operator off from trusted peers; out-of-band confirmation required.
rationale.contact.unblock: Social-engineering unblock of a previously banned peer; out-of-band confirmation required.
rationale.privacy.set: Broadcast-surface change (last-seen, profile photo, status) — operator must initiate.
rationale.group.leave: Silent exit from a trusted group; operator must initiate.
rationale.session.logoutAll: Catastrophic: unpairs every device. Never from an inbound envelope.
rationale.session.logout: Single-device unlink. Inbound envelope must never reset the operator's daemon; out-of-band re-pair required.
